text:
Geelani most likely replaced Maulvi Umar Farooq as APHC chairman in 1998; a Wikipedia infobox from the search lists his chairmanship as 1998–2000, preceded by Umar Farooq. The 2003 date in the team note doesn't fit: the 2003 split made Geelani and Umar Farooq rival chairmen of separate factions rather than a handover, and I found no support for the 2002-elections account. I haven't read the Wikipedia pages in full, so this rests on search snippets.

CONFIDENCE: 65
